problem:
The position vector $r(t)$ of a particle $P$ relative to a fixed origin $O$ at time $t$ is given by

$$
r(t)=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡t,\,{e}^{3t}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the components of the acceleration vector $a$ at time $t.$

$a=⟨${{field-1}},{{field-2}}$⟩$

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation

feedback.problem:
The velocity vector $v=⟨u,v⟩$ of a particle $P$ at time $t$ is given by

$$
v=⟨\frac{6}{t},\,3{t}^{2}⟩.
$$

Calculate the components of the acceleration vector $a$ at time $t=3.$ Do not round the answers.

$a(3)=⟨${{field-1}},{{field-2}}$⟩$
feedback.worked_solution:
To compute the acceleration vector, we differentiate the velocity vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t},\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{6}{t}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(3{t}^{2})⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{6}{{t}^{2}},\,6t⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, to find the acceleration at time $t=3,$ we substitute $t=3$ into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(3) & =⟨-\frac{6}{(3)^{2}},\,6(3)⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{6}{9},\,18⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{2}{3},\,18⟩\end{aligned}
$$
